questions.q: The minimum age to drive a commercial vehicle from Texas into another state is
questions.explanation: Interstate commerce requires the driver to be at least 21. That federal age applies to a driver leaving this state.

questions.q: You live in Texas and drive a CMV. Who issues the CDL?
options: The state that titled the truck
The state where the load started
questions.explanation: A CDL is issued by your state of domicile, the state where you live.

questions.q: Besides General Knowledge, a Texas Class A or B CDL applicant must pass which state knowledge test?
questions.explanation: DPS gives Class A and B applicants the Texas Commercial Rules test as well as General Knowledge, plus any endorsement tests.

questions.q: What score do you need to pass each Texas CDL knowledge test?
questions.explanation: The Texas CDL handbook: "A score of 80% or higher is required to pass each section."

questions.q: Since June 1, 2026, Texas gives CDL knowledge tests in
questions.explanation: DPS gives all CDL knowledge tests in English starting June 1, 2026.

questions.q: A Texas Class C CDL covers a vehicle designed to carry
options: Any number of passengers under 26,001 pounds
questions.explanation: In Texas a Class C CDL is for vehicles designed for 16 to 23 passengers including the driver, or vehicles hauling placarded hazardous materials. 24 or more passengers is Class B.

questions.q: A driver who is 19 holds a Texas CDL. Where may they drive a commercial vehicle?
options: In Texas and its neighboring states
Only with a CDL holder 21 or older aboard
questions.explanation: Texas issues CDLs at 18, but federal rules (49 CFR 391.11) require drivers in interstate commerce to be at least 21. A driver under 21 may drive commercial vehicles only within Texas.

questions.q: In Texas, what is the youngest age to drive a commercial vehicle only within the state?
questions.explanation: Texas allows intrastate commercial driving at 18 years; interstate driving requires 21.
questions.remember: Texas: in-state CDL driving at 18 years.
